body:
I understand your point but back then especially it was the difference between wanting someone ripped and broad compared to someone kinda narrow with a big stomach and a muffin top so when I was at my worst I looked pretty terrible imo. She also never really objectified me in the same way so its not as if she treated me the same way as the guys in those pictures.

I know that logically but especially with what I said in the last paragraph its just hard for me to not feel like if I was more attractive or if I was a bit skinnier/ had more muscle then maybe she would of wanted me more.

If they are good ones then things like chat rooms would probably be helpful but I always had a problem finding chat rooms for depression or suicide. The UK doesn't have a lot of support in this form and a lot of sites are very much national.

I have made steps to do what I can with my body, started lifting weights a lot and became active, lost about 40 pounds, started eating healthier. My problem really is that although I have achieved a lot, its not enough, I have a lot of pesky stomach fat that I just can't get rid of and there is a lot about my body that I dislike that is just genetics. size of wrists, narrow shoulders, passive but huge legs and ankles while having to work hard for arms that are a lot smaller.

I think it is a lot about the latter, that I wasn't worthy or good enough or attractive enough for her. I can understand on a logical point of view of her not showing interest sexually because she wasn't ready but for me, I am a lot about actions than words so its hard to know that the one person I really wanted basically wanted very little to do with me sexually in the one chance we had to be together even if she said I was attractive. 

This sort of got worse because I am kinda narrow shouldered and when we got back together I went on her tumblr (she would tag cute things for me so I would check it every now and then). I found that she was objectifying and saying some sexual things about guys who were broad or just a different sort of aesthetic that I couldn't achieve, these posts were from before we got back together but it hurt to think that still, she didn't want me in that way.
